author: KEXP
description: French trio SLIFT spiral into space during their latest Live on KEXP session. Performing a special show in our Gathering Space, the heavy psych rockers deliver a performance of "Fantasia" and more.
title: SLIFT performs "Fantasia" & more Live on KEXP
